story_type: rescuers capsize too: three federal agents and two boaters in night swells, thermal camera, helicopter hoists
hook: They went out to save two boaters. Then their boat flipped too.
narration: At night, in ten foot swells, a man stood on an upside down hull and waved for help.
He was one of three federal agents who had gone out to save two boaters off Puerto Rico.
Those boaters had capsized. Then the agents' boat capsized too, and threw all three into the water.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk and a Puerto Rico Police aircrew flew out to find five people in the dark.
A thermal camera sees body heat, so a head in black water glows white on the screen.
The Jayhawk lowered its rescue swimmer into the swells, right beside them.
Then the hoist lifted them, one at a time, up toward the open door.
outcome: The two aircrews pulled all five people out of the sea, and every one of them was treated for only minor injuries.

location_card.place: Off Isla de Cabras, Toa Baja, Puerto Rico

title: Rescuers capsized too, in 10-foot swells
description:
On the night of March 30, 2026, three CBP marine agents capsized in 10-foot swells off Isla de Cabras, Toa Baja, Puerto Rico, while trying to rescue two boaters whose own boat had flipped. A Coast Guard MH-60T Jayhawk crew and a Puerto Rico Police aircrew rescued all five.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1001660/coast-guard-puerto-rico-police-aircrews-rescue-3-federal-agents-and-2-boaters-off-isla-de-cabras-toa-baja
